name: Plaid Dashboard MCP
summary: Plaid's hosted MCP server with Production diagnostics: debug Items, review Link conversion and check usage metrics.
description: Remote Streamable HTTP server at https://api.dashboard.plaid.com/mcp/. It works only with Production data, and your team must have Production access for at least one Plaid product. For direct API use, create an OAuth token with the `mcp:dashboard` scope via /oauth/token (client_credentials) and send it as a Bearer token; it also works as a remote MCP tool in OpenAI and Anthropic APIs. Plaid says it is under active development with possible breaking changes and limited support. A separate local MCP server for development (mock data, docs search, Sandbox tokens, webhook simulation) ships in the MIT-licensed plaid/ai-coding-toolkit.

agent_access.notes: OAuth token with scope mcp:dashboard from POST https://production.plaid.com/oauth/token.
